title: Rajasthan Safai Karmchari Online Form 2026 (24,752 posts)
postName: Safai Karamchari / Sanitation Worker – Urban Local Bodies (Advt. 01/2026)
vacancyDetails: 24,752 Safai Karamchari posts across ~183 urban local bodies (Nagar Nigam / Palika / Parishad) in Rajasthan on contractual / scheme basis as notified
qualification: As per LSG Rajasthan Advt 01/2026 – open to candidates meeting residence and age criteria (including minimal educational requirement as per notification)
ageLimit: 21 to 40 years (relaxations as per Rajasthan Govt rules)
applicationFee: OTR / Application: General ₹600 | OBC / SC / ST / PH ₹400 (as reported)
selectionProcess: Online Application (SSO / LSG portal) → Merit / Selection as per local body rules → Document Verification → Engagement
documentsRequired: SSO ID, photo, signature, residence proof, category certificate, Aadhaar, bank details
howToApply:
1. Login at https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in
2. Open Citizen Apps (G2C) → Recruitment Portal
3. Complete OTR if required
4. Select one urban local body preference and fill Safai Karamchari form
5. Pay fee and submit between 15 August 2026 and 28 September 2026
shortDescription: Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Online Form 2026 for 24,752 posts. Apply 15 August–28 September 2026 via SSO / LSG portal. Age 21–40 years.
content:
The Local Self Government Department (LSG), Rajasthan has announced recruitment of Safai Karamchari for urban local bodies under Advt. 01/2026.

Total posts: 24,752. Online applications: 15 August 2026 to 28 September 2026.

Key points

  • Apply for only one of the ~183 urban local bodies
  • Application via SSO Rajasthan / LSG recruitment portal
  • Age generally 21 to 40 years
  • OTR may be mandatory before final submission

Official portals: sso.rajasthan.gov.in and lsg.urban.rajasthan.gov.in. Read the full advertisement for fee, documents and selection method before applying.
